name: Sidereal-Lament
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a nearby asteroid belt.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Whoever controls helium-3 controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
